newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese pound virtually flat on dollar in week.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese pound virtually flat on dollar in week.

text.p: The Lebanese pound was virtually flat against the dollar in the week ended on Friday, and dealers said the market was very quiet during the three working days.

The Bank of Lebanon lowered its bid-offer intervention band during the week to 1,538.5-1,548 pounds per dollar from 1,539-1,548, and the dollar traded at the bottom of the band throughout the week, dealers said.

Nabil Abou Jaoude, Treasury and Forex Manager at Banque Libanaise pour Le Commerce, said trade was very quiet and restricted to a tight range of up to 50 piastres at the bid end of the intervention band, putting it at 1,538.5-1,539.
Last week the dollar closed at 1,539-1,539.5 pound in interbank trading.
All demand for dollars were met by commercial banks, Abou Jaoude said.
Markets were closed on Tuesday and Wednesday for the Martyrs Day and Moslem New Year holidays.
